sensors.name: light sensor left (LLIGHT), light from above

control_flow: followInTheDark: in dim light, steer by the line tracker's brightness (below 90 %: curve left 10/30; above 90 %: curve right 30/10; exactly 90 %: call avoidWalls); in bright light call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: in dim light, turn right 20° if something is on the left, turn left 20° if something is on the right, else call driveInTheDark; in bright light call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: in dim light drive forward at 30 %; in bright light call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if something is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: on black curve left 10/40; otherwise curve right 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line when there is one under the robot, and drive straight where there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.
